method: ref existence from one live ls-remote --refs (remote truth, no local dependency); hexes from git cat-file -t, which only asks MY object store
caveat: 'not_in_local_store' is NOT a dead-coordinate verdict -- another lane's blob can be live on the remote and simply unfetched here. Settling it would need a fetch nobody authorised, so this tool does not pretend to have settled it.
